## Layout and communication environment (`BACKEND` and the rank variables) {#sec-ch12-layout}

### Summary

Before any block exists, each process reads a few environment variables: how many processes the run has, which one
it is, where they meet, which device it uses and which communication library joins them. This section lists those
variables and their defaults, and the one rule a run with more than one process must follow: set `MASTER_PORT`.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Selects ranks, rendezvous, device and communication backend.

**Data.** Launch environment in; layout options and process group out.

**Placement.** Options construction, YAML parsing, then group setup.

**Activation.** One CPU process by default; backend follows the compiled platform default.

**Guarantee / limits.** `MASTER_PORT` is required when either world size exceeds one.

**Evidence.** Tests below, @tbl-ch12-layout-tests; solver ctests were not run.
:::

| environment | default | role |
|---|---|---|
| `BACKEND` | the compiled platform default | process-group backend; wins over the YAML key |
| `PROCESS_RANK` | `RANK`, then 0 | the process rank; `rank` itself is `RANK` when that is set, else this value |
| `PROCESS_WORLD_SIZE` | `WORLD_SIZE`, then 1 | process count |
| `WORLD_SIZE` | the process world size | global world size |
| `LOCAL_RANK` | 0 | local rank |
| `MASTER_ADDR` | `127.0.0.1` | rendezvous address |
| `MASTER_PORT` | a random port, single process only | rendezvous port; required when either world size exceeds one |
| `DEVICE`, `DEVICE_ID` | `cpu`, $-1$ | device choice |
| `COMMUX_COALESCE`, `COMMUX_GROUP` | set to 1 if unset | commux batching, written before the UCX group starts |
| `UCX_TLS` | set to exclude the CUDA transports if unset on a CPU device | UCX transport selection |
| `WORKSPACE`, `NC_HOME` | the current directory, unset | package-build search paths only |

: Launch variables at the pin. {#tbl-ch12-layout-variables}

### Derivation

No continuum derivation applies. Rank metadata selects the process topology; the block layout and the neighbour
exchange of @sec-ch03 and @sec-ch14 then follow it. A common rendezvous port is necessary for the processes to
join one group, so automatic port selection is admissible only for one process. Check line `[C8]` enumerates
the 53 independent port assignments over port sets of size two and three and one to three processes: the group
forms for every assignment only with a single process, and a port given to all of them forms it at every size
[check `src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.py`, output
`src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.out`].

### Numerical method

The constructor `LayoutOptionsImpl::LayoutOptionsImpl`
({{< code src/layout/layout.cpp LayoutOptionsImpl::LayoutOptionsImpl >}}) reads `BACKEND` with the default of
`default_backend` ({{< code src/layout/layout.cpp default_backend >}}), the rank and world-size variables with
the fallbacks of the table, `MASTER_ADDR`, and `MASTER_PORT`, which it draws at random when unset and both
world sizes are one and refuses to leave unset otherwise; then `DEVICE_ID` and `DEVICE`. `LayoutOptionsImpl::from_yaml`
({{< code src/layout/layout.cpp LayoutOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}) reads the `distribute`[^rg-918a29259c84] block (`layout`[^rg-50cea80c1365],
`nb1`[^rg-de08e3b2f851], `nb2`[^rg-371079b426b9], `nb3`[^rg-272560a42656], `verbose`, `blocks_per_process`[^rg-a3b3babe2528], `backend`) and then re-reads `BACKEND` and `DEVICE` from
the environment, so the YAML backend value is never used. When a UCX process group starts, `_init_ucx`
({{< code src/layout/process_group_ucx.cpp ProcessGroupContext::_init_ucx >}}) writes the three UCX defaults
with `set_default_env` ({{< code src/layout/process_group_ucx.cpp set_default_env >}}), only where the variable
is unset. These controls affect seam communication, not stencil coefficients; wrong rank settings invalidate a
multi-rank numerical comparison rather than change a scheme.

### Code

**How to use it.** For two CPU processes, give both ranks the same reachable `MASTER_ADDR` and unused
`MASTER_PORT`, set `PROCESS_WORLD_SIZE=2` and `WORLD_SIZE=2`, and give each process its distinct rank.
For rank zero, with the Straka driver and its two-block deck in `build/bin`
([Install and run](#sec-preface-install)), the command is:

```bash
env PROCESS_RANK=0 RANK=0 PROCESS_WORLD_SIZE=2 WORLD_SIZE=2 \
  MASTER_ADDR=127.0.0.1 MASTER_PORT=29573 DEVICE=cpu BACKEND=gloo \
  ./straka.release straka_proc2.yaml
```

Rank one runs the same command, in a second terminal, with `PROCESS_RANK=1 RANK=1`. Only rank 0 prints cycle lines, so rank 1 prints little. The loopback address
works only on one host. Choose a backend present in the build. YAML `distribute/backend` is accepted but ignored.
Omitting the port refuses the options with "MASTER_PORT must be set for multi-process runs", followed by
both world sizes and the requirement that all ranks rendezvous on the same TCPStore.

`LayoutOptionsImpl::LayoutOptionsImpl` ({{< code src/layout/layout.cpp LayoutOptionsImpl::LayoutOptionsImpl >}}) contains this selection step:

```cpp
  auto master_port_env = std::getenv("MASTER_PORT");
  if (master_port_env) {
    master_port(std::stoi(master_port_env));
```

The provided value is used directly. The following `else` branch enforces the one-process random-port rule;
`[C8]` enumerates why independent random choices cannot guarantee a shared port for several processes.

| what | code link | symbol | switch |
|---|---|---|---|
| backend default | {{< code src/layout/layout.cpp default_backend >}} | `default_backend` | `USE_UCX` |
| options | {{< code src/layout/layout.cpp LayoutOptionsImpl::LayoutOptionsImpl >}} | `MASTER_PORT` | `BACKEND` and the rank variables |
| yaml | {{< code src/layout/layout.cpp LayoutOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}} | `backend` | `distribute/*` |
| helpers | {{< code src/layout/layout.hpp get_rank >}} | `get_rank` | `RANK` |
| ucx env | {{< code src/layout/process_group_ucx.cpp set_default_env >}} | `set_default_env` | `COMMUX_*`, `UCX_TLS` |
| ucx start | {{< code src/layout/process_group_ucx.cpp ProcessGroupContext::_init_ucx >}} | `_init_ucx` | `BACKEND` |
| package build | {{< code setup.py nc_home >}} | `nc_home` | `NC_HOME`, `WORKSPACE` |

: Implementation sites for the layout environment. {#tbl-ch12-layout-code}

1. Construct the layout options from the environment and the compiled default; refuse a multi-process world
   without a port. The anchor `MASTER_PORT` is in
   {{< code src/layout/layout.cpp LayoutOptionsImpl::LayoutOptionsImpl >}}.
2. Read the `distribute` block and let the environment override `BACKEND` and `DEVICE`. The anchor `backend`
   is in {{< code src/layout/layout.cpp LayoutOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}.
3. Start the compiled process group; on UCX write the missing defaults first. The anchor `_init_ucx` is in
   {{< code src/layout/process_group_ucx.cpp ProcessGroupContext::_init_ucx >}}.

|---|---|---|---|
| `test_process_group.<b>` | the platform default with `BACKEND` unset; `BACKEND=gloo` overrides; the YAML key is ignored; a random port in 29500 to 29600 for one process; a missing port is refused at world size two; a provided port is kept; a single process owns no group | exact strings; expected exceptions | the test |
| `configuration_check.py` `[C8]` (report check) | the shared-port assignment predicate | exact symbolic or Boolean equality | the independent check |

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
No network or multi-rank run is performed here. A YAML backend value cannot override the environment. A
run-time backend selection does not prove that its library was compiled and linked. `LOCAL_RANK` has a second
default in the Python launch helper, the rank modulo the GPU count (@sec-ch14).

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
